Retain and show final300; do not reject on CE alone or attribute all multi-arm gains uniquely to multiple references. Selection objective averages three reference CEs and is not human reply quality.

conclusion: Useful candidate behaviour changes, especially on familiar template families and a call paraphrase; exact user wording and important constraints remain unresolved. Original defaults retained.
